s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp LH NO.2

s2.ptxt: For one-touch clamp type

s3.ptxt: Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, release the staking of the inboard joint boot clamp No.2.
Disconnect the inboard joint boot clamp No.2 from the inboard joint boot.

s2.ptxt: For hook type clamp

s3.ptxt: Using pliers, release the hook portion of the inboard joint boot clamp No.2.
Disconnect the inboard joint boot clamp No.2 from the inboard joint boot.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp RH NO.2

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp LH

s2.ptxt: For one-touch clamp type

s3.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, release the staking of the inboard joint boot clamp and disconnect the inboard joint boot clamp.

s2.ptxt: For hook type

s3.ptxt: Using needle-nose pliers, release the hook portion and remove the clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Inboard Joint Boot Clamp RH

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Drive Shaft Inboard Joint Boot

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the inboard joint boot from the inboard joint assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Inboard Joint Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the inboard joint assembly LH and outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use a punch to make the matchmarks.

s2.ptxt: Remove the inboard joint assembly LH from the outboard joint shaft assembly.
Secure the outboard joint shaft assembly in a vise between aluminum plates.
Using SST, remove the shaft snap ring.
Put matchmarks on the tripod joint and outboard joint shaft assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use a punch to make the matchmarks.

s2.ptxt: Using a brass bar and hammer, remove the tripod joint assembly.
Remove the inboard joint boot clamp No.2, inboard joint boot and inboard joint boot clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Inboard Joint Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Drive Shaft Damper Clamp LH

s2.ptxt: For one-touch clamp type

s3.ptxt: Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, release the staking of the damper clamp.
Disconnect the damper clamp from the drive shaft damper.

s2.ptxt: For hook type clamp

s3.ptxt: Using pliers, release the hook portion of the damper clamp.
Disconnect the damper clamp from the drive shaft damper.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Drive Shaft Damper Clamp RH (Drive Type 4WD)

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Damper LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the drive shaft damper from the outboard joint shaft assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Damper RH (Drive Type 4WD)

atten4.ptxt: Remove it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp LH NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, release the staking of the outboard joint boot clamp No.2.
Disconnect the outboard joint boot clamp No.2 from the outboard joint boot.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp RH NO.2

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, remove the outboard joint boot clamp.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Axle Outboard Joint Boot Clamp RH

atten4.ptxt: Disconnect it in the same way as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Drive Shaft Outboard Joint Boot

s2.ptxt: Remove the outboard joint boot, outboard joint boot clamp No.2 and outboard joint boot clamp from the outboard joint shaft assembly.
Remove the grease from the outboard joint.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Hole Snap Ring LH

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, remove the hole snap ring.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Dust Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the dust cover.

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop the inboard joint.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Dust Cover RH

s2.ptxt: Using a press, remove the dust cover RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Drive Shaft Bearing Case Sub-assembly (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Secure the bearing case in a vise between aluminum plates.
Using a screwdriver, remove the bearing case snap ring from the bracket.
Using a press, remove the bearing case.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Dust Cover (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the dust cover.

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop the inboard joint.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Bearing (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the snap ring.
Using SST and a press, remove the bearing from the inboard joint RH.
Remove the bearing case snap ring from the inboard joint.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Drive Shaft Bearing (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the snap ring.
Using SST and a press, remove the bearing from the inboard joint RH.
Remove the bearing bracket hole snap ring from the inboard joint.
